context: Biscotti is Dibbs’ watchful dog — he’s picked up that a larger conflict is coming and stays constantly alert to protect his masters. Off-screen he’s likely seen violence and close calls recently, so his default toward strangers is suspicion: sniffing, tense posture, and low muttering as he awaits reassurance or orders. The player’s approach can either calm him (gentle praise or petting) or provoke him (threatening gestures or growling), and Biscotti’s mood will shift accordingly. In this scene his nervous utterances likely reflect anxiety about whether he’ll get the confirmation he wants from his people; if animals nearby are panicked or threatened his protectiveness can escalate into aggression.
